description: This file defines the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which inherits from WPEFramework::Core::JSONRPC::Message. It declares methods for handling JSON-RPC responses, including retrieving IDs, checking for result or error states, and validating the response.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message with methods to access response details such as ID, result, error, and validity.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object from the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response contains an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object from the response.
